prompt:

Reference 2 is the canonical costume sheet: use the SIDE-VIEW FIGURE (second figure) for the narrow profile torso/hips, facing RIGHT. References 3/4 are style only.

Keep exact 1672x941 transparent canvas. Make the character about 800px tall: top ear at y=47, BOTH lowest shoe-ground contact points at y=847. Place body near canvas center, feet roughly at x=760 and x=945. Empty bottom margin about94px. Do not add a groundline or shadow.
Preserve approved outfit: coral pink long hair swept gently back left, black-white checker headband, upright black ear ornaments/cyan marks, paired gold-rimmed speaker discs (far one partly occluded), cyan bow AND necktie, black collar, opaque white top, white off-shoulder puffy jacket with cyan trims, PURE BLACK shorts, silver scrolling waist buckle, black thigh-highs, white sneakers purple laces yellow details cyan sole trim. No letters/logos on shoes.
Clear inked outline, restrained flat cel shading, simplified readable main lines for fluorescent line-art conversion. Fully clothed, neutral profile. No scenic elements, no motion lines, no text/watermarks/red thread. Genuine transparency.
